candidates.title: The Duchess Recognizes the Ring
candidates.hook: In E026-B0031 at 01:13.80 (2.0s in), the bedridden Duchess questions Juliana: 'Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?'
candidates.cliffhanger: In E026-B0049/E026-B0051, the Duchess frantically grips Juliana's hand around the signet ring, demanding to know where she got it before the scene cuts to black.
candidates.standalone_context: A bedridden duchess realizes her nurse is no ordinary servant; when Juliana rests her hand, the elder woman spots a distinctive family signet ring and reacts in shock.
candidates.why_it_works: The intimate mystery of a noble girl working as a servant explodes when an heirloom ring triggers an urgent, unanswered family interrogation.

resolved_segments.start_text: Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.
resolved_segments.end_text: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's two weathered hands tightly clasping Juliana's hand, holding the signet ring between them as a dramatic orchestral cliffhanger chord swells, cutting sharply to black.

candidates.title: Framed for the Poisoning
candidates.hook: In E027-B0062 at 01:38.80 (1.0s in), the Blond Nobleman corners Juliana with the cold accusation: 'And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed...'
candidates.cliffhanger: In E027-B0091/E027-B0095, the nobleman commands guards to seize Juliana after framing her antidote as poison, dragging her backward into darkness.
candidates.standalone_context: Aristocrats enter a sickroom and deliberately manipulate a maid's explanation of giving an antidote into a confession of poisoning the Duchess.
candidates.why_it_works: A life-saving act is ruthlessly twisted into high treason before the protagonist is dragged off to the dungeons.

resolved_segments.start_text: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.
resolved_segments.end_text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.

candidates.title: Lady Juliana Ashcroft Unmasked
candidates.hook: In E028-B0073 at 01:38.20 (0.8s in), Catherine raises her eyes from a confiscated ledger with a predatory smile, pronouncing: 'Lady Juliana Ashcroft.'
candidates.cliffhanger: In E028-B0094/E028-B0096, Catherine vows to present the botanical book to the magistrate to send Juliana to the gallows as guards haul her away.
candidates.standalone_context: Catherine discovers that a captured maid is actually a disgraced aristocrat and declares she will use her mother's herbal book to hang her.
candidates.why_it_works: Juliana's secret identity is exposed by her bitter rival, setting up an immediate death sentence using her own mother's legacy.

resolved_segments.start_text: Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.
resolved_segments.end_text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eyes as the guard wrenches her backward into the dark hallway, cutting sharply to black.

candidates.title: The Witchcraft Accusation
candidates.hook: In E029-B0020 at 00:31.90 (0.0s in), Catherine flips through Juliana's botanical book and threatens: 'The magistrate will call it witchcraft.'
candidates.cliffhanger: In E029-B0048/E029-B0051, Catherine scoffs at the idea that Juliana's penniless veteran husband could stop them as the dungeon doors slam shut.
candidates.standalone_context: An arrogant noblewoman informs a captive that her medical remedy book will be branded as witchcraft before the magistrate so she will hang.
candidates.why_it_works: The clip establishes the lethal trap facing Juliana while challenging whether her absent husband has any power to save her.

resolved_segments.start_text: Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.
resolved_segments.end_text: Wide shot tracking behind the guards as they march Juliana down the vaulted, puddle-strewn corridor toward the heavy iron cell door.

candidates.title: The Witchcraft Conspiracy
candidates.hook: In E030-B0043 at 01:25.80 (0.2s in), the Elder Nobleman settles the debate in the study by declaring: 'Then call it witchcraft.'
candidates.cliffhanger: In E030-B0067 at 02:17.50, the Elder Nobleman chillingly concludes: 'Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.'
candidates.standalone_context: Three conspiring nobles plot to eliminate an inconvenient female prisoner by fabricating witchcraft charges and buying the jury.
candidates.why_it_works: The cold, clinical fabrication of a capital crime against an unseen victim reveals the full scale of corruption Juliana is up against.
candidates.concerns: Juliana herself does not appear on screen in this excerpt, though the conspiratorial stakes are explicitly detailed.

resolved_segments.start_text: Tight close-up of the Elder Nobleman's face illuminated by warm firelight.
resolved_segments.end_text: "Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch."

candidates.title: Face to Face With the Branding Iron
candidates.hook: In E032-B0091 at 01:59.60 (0.1s in), Catherine brandishes a red-hot branding iron like a weapon, shrieking frantically: 'Silence! Silence!'
candidates.cliffhanger: In E032-B0116/E032-B0117, Catherine plunges the glowing branding rod directly toward Juliana's face, stopping millimeters from her eye before a hard cut to black.
candidates.standalone_context: A chained prisoner shames her wealthy tormentor for needing to intimidate a bound woman, driving the noblewoman into a violent frenzy.
candidates.why_it_works: Moral victory triggers unhinged physical retaliation, ending at the exact second a glowing branding iron threatens to blind the heroine.

resolved_segments.start_text: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.
resolved_segments.end_text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.

candidates.title: Defiance Before the Gavel
candidates.hook: In E034-B0089 at 02:19.60 (0.4s in), the prosecutor smirks at the prisoner's dock: 'Even now, she refuses to repent.'
candidates.cliffhanger: In E034-B0114/E034-B0116, the Judge stands tall and raises his hand to pronounce Juliana's final sentence for witchcraft as the courtroom falls dead silent.
candidates.standalone_context: On trial for witchcraft, Lady Juliana publicly refuses the judge's demand to renounce her healing, defending medicine against fearful rulers.
candidates.why_it_works: High courtroom drama pits an unbroken woman against an authoritarian court, freezing just as her sentence of execution is delivered.

resolved_segments.start_text: Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.
resolved_segments.end_text: The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

candidates.title: The Traitors of Ashwood
candidates.hook: In E035-B0046/E035-B0047 at 01:41.50 (0.3s in), Alexander crushes a tactical map in his fist and announces: 'My men were slaughtered.'
candidates.cliffhanger: In E035-B0070/E035-B0071, Alexander reveals that the traitors who ordered the slaughter of his men are the very rulers governing Ashwood today.
candidates.standalone_context: A scarred veteran explains to his mother that the military ambush presumed to have killed him was deliberate treason ordered by the current rulers.
candidates.why_it_works: A soldier's tragic survival narrative transforms into an explosive revelation of high-level political treason.
candidates.concerns: The scene relies entirely on dialogue exposition recounting a past battlefield ambush rather than present physical action.

resolved_segments.start_text: Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.
resolved_segments.end_text: A sudden, ominous orchestral crescendo swells dramatically into silence.
